profile.headline: Software Engineer - Boeing
profile.summary: Caedin is a software developer with experience in .NET, Java, and C. His first job was at GMSDND where he developed security applications, and websites. During his first two years of college was involved with the  juggling club, Residence Life as an RA, and Colorado Space Grant as a payload designed for WARP-SPEED.  He is currently looking for internship opportunities in computer science. On the side he enjoys reading fantasy/sci-fi and learning new languages.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Developed and maintained critical .NET security projects, including a 10,000-line common library that strengthened service security 
across multiple applications in an agile environment.
 • Diagnosed and resolved complex client-side software and environment issues, debugging across VoIP/PBX systems, web hosting 
configurations, and Windows environments to ensure continuous application uptime.
 • Managed a portfolio of 15+ client websites on Azure, automating SSL certificate renewals with Let's Encrypt and streamlining DNS 
management, thereby supporting containerization fundamentals and enhancing overall system resilience.

company.name: Grand Mesa Software Development & Network Design, Inc.

positions.title: Resident Advisor
positions.description:
Served as an advisor and mentor to 34 students, while promoting socialization between residents.
Plan and execute events for community of 250+, on topics such as academics, social justice, and community
Budget and allocate money used for hall and floor events.

positions.title: WARP-SPEED
positions.description: Systems Engineer for ACES, a DemoSat project through Colorado Space Grant. The purpose of the project was to test if aerogel was a suitable replacement for the polyethylene foam insulation that most projects use. My responsibilities were designing the structure of the payload, and assisting with the programming of the sensors.
